footer.description: Ek saanjnaatmak khel aur yaadon ki sahayata platform jo dementia se prabhavit bade-bujurg upyogkartaon ko judne wali gatiividhiyon aur komal yaad-dilaane ke zariye sahyog dene ke liye banaya gaya hai.

footer.sihCredit: Smart India Hackathon 2026 ke liye banaya gaya

home.heroDesc: Ek AI-powered saanjnaatmak aur rozmarra jeevan ka saathi jo bade-bujurg upyogkartaon ko vyast rehne, maene-bhare pal yaad rakhne, dinacharya ka paalan karne aur swatantrata banaye rakhne mein madad karta hai.

featureCognitive.title: Saanjnaatmak Khel
featureCognitive.desc: Yaad, Dhyaan, Tark, Bhasha, Pehchaan aur Rozmarra jeevan shreniyon mein judne wali gatiividhiyaan. Aapki dilchaspion aur kathinai ke shtar ke hisaab se niji.

featureMemory.title: Niji Yaadon ka Profile
featureMemory.desc: Saaf-saadhi baat-cheet ke zariye apni yaadon, pasando, shaukon aur khaas logon ka profile banayein.

featureAssistant.title: Voice-Pehle AI Sahayak
featureAssistant.desc: Apne AI saathi se naturally baat karein. Sawal poochhein, maargdarshan lein, ya bas dostana baat-cheet karein.

home.howItWorksDesc: Zyada judne wale aur niji anubhav ke liye chaar aasaan kadam.

step1.title: Apna Profile Banayein
step1.desc: Anubhav ko niji banane ke liye mool jaankari, bhasha ki pasand aur sahaj-upyogita ki zarooratein jodein.

step2.title: Yaadon ka Profile Banayein
step2.desc: Aasaan vaakalap se apni priya yaadein, shauq, log aur rozmarra ki pasanden sajhed karein.

step3.title: Khelein aur Judein
step3.desc: Sirf aapke liye bane khel aur gatiividhiyaan — aapki raftaar par, aapke shtar par.

step4.title: Saath Milakar Pragati Dekhein
step4.desc: Apni sadgatha badhti dekhein aur har uplabdhi ko parivar aur dekhbhaal karne walon ke saath manayen.

home.personalizationDesc: Hamara AI loop aapse lagatar seekhta hai, har gatiividhi ko aapke anokhe saanjnaatmak dhandhon aur dilchaspion ke hisaab se dhalta hai.
home.trustedByFamilies: Poorvi Uttari Kshetra ke parivaaron ka bharosa

testimonial1.quote: Meri maa ab roz ke khel ka intezaar karti hain. Ye unki dinacharya ka hissa ban gaya hai aur woh sach mein iska aanand leti hain.

testimonial2.quote: Memory profile ki khaasiyat mujhe woh naam aur kahaniyaan yaad karne mein madad karti hai jo maine soche the kho gayi. Ye ek dayalu dost se baat karne jaisa lagta hai.

testimonial3.quote: Dekhbhaal karne wale ke roop mein, progress tracking mujhe mann ki shanti deta hai. Main dekh sakta hoon ki mere pita ji har din jude rehte hain.

home.ctaTitle: Apni Yatra Shuru Karne Ke Liye Taiyaar?
home.ctaDesc: Hazaaroon parivaaron ke saath judein jo Pixel Players ka istemal karke saanjnaatmak swasthya aur rozmarra swatantrata ka sahyog le rahe hain.

about.title: Pixel Players ke baare mein
about.headerDesc: Poorvi Uttari Kshetra ke bade-bujurg upyogkartaon ke liye dekhbhaal ke saath banaya gaya
about.missionP1: Humein vishwas hai ki har bade-bujurg vyakti ko judne wale, niji upkaranon ka prayog milna chahiye jo saanjnaatmak swasthya aur rozmarra ki swatantrata ka sahyog karein. Hamara lakshya AI takniki aur dayala bade-bujurg dekhbhaal ke beech ki khaali poori karna hai.
about.missionP2: AI-pranit niji gatiividhiyon, komal yaad-dilaane aur maene-bhare saamaajik rishton ke zariye, hum bade logon ki saanjnaatmak yogyataayein banaye rakhne, jeevan se jude rahne aur un cheezo ko karte rahne mein madad karna chahte hain jo woh karna pyaar karte hain.
about.problemTitle: Woh Samasya Jo Hum Suljha Rahe Hain
about.problemDesc: Bhaarat mein kai laakh bade logon ko saanjnaatmak girwaat hota hai, aur unke paas manoranjak, sanskritik roop se relevant mansik swasthya upkaranon tak seemit pahunch hai.
about.statCognitive: Bhaarat mein saanjnaatmak girwaat se prabhavit bade log
about.statAccess: Mansik swasthya upkaranon tak seemit pahunch rakhne wale

approachAi.title: AI-Pranit Nijikaran
approachAi.desc: Har gatiividhi vyakti ke hisaab se banayi jaati hai. Hamara AI aapki baat-cheet se seekhta hai, waqt par kathinai samajhta hai, aur aapki dilchaspion aur saanjnaatmak dhandhon ke anukool gatiividhiyaan sujhaata hai.

approachCulture.title: Sanskritik Roop Se Upayukt
approachCulture.desc: Vishesh roop se Bhaaratiya bade upyogkartaon ke liye banayi gayi saamagri — jaane-pehchaane naam, kshetriya sandarbh, sanskritik roop se upayukt vishay aur Bhaaratiya bhashaon ka samarthan.

approachPrivacy.title: Gopniyata Sabse Pehle
approachPrivacy.desc: Aapka data aapka hai. Hum end-to-end encryption, jahan mumkin ho on-device processing ka istemal karte hain, aur aapko poora niyantran dete hain ki kya sajhed kiya jaye aur kya niji rahe.

about.focusTitle: Poorvi Uttari Kshetra Ke Liye Banaya Gaya
about.focusDesc: Bhaarat ke Poorvi Uttari rajyon mein bade-bujurg samudaayon ki vividh sanskritiyon, bhashaon aur zarooraton ki gehri samajh ke saath banaya gaya.
about.languageSupportDesc: Samudaay ki zarooraton ke hisaab se aur bhashayein jodi gayi jaayengi. Hamara voice-pehle tareeqa un upyogkartaon ke liye bhi pahunch sunishchit karta hai jinme seemit padhai-likhayi hai.
about.designedForIndiaDesc: Sanskritik roop se sajavet, bhaashai roop se vividh, aur Bhaaratiya bade upyogkartaon ke liye sahanubhooti ke saath banaya gaya.

chat.suggMemory: Mujhe ek yaad ke baare mein batayein
chat.suggLost: Main thoda sa bhatka sa mehsoos kar raha hoon
chat.greeting1: {{greeting}}, {{name}}! Main aapka Memory Buddy hoon. Main hamesha aapke liye yahin hoon — aap kabhi akele nahi hain.
chat.greeting2:
Aaj main aapki kaise madad kar sakta hoon?

• Mere din mein kya ho raha hai
• Ek yaad ke baare mein batayein
• Ek komal khel shuru karein
• Ya bas baat karein — main hamesha sunta hoon.
chat.respHello: Phir se namaste, {{name}}! Aapki baat sunke bahut achha laga. Aapke din ko kaun si cheez roshan karegi — ek khushi wali yaad ki baat-cheet, ya ek komal khel?
chat.respWhoAreYou: Main aapka Memory Buddy hoon, {{name}} — ek dostana saathi jo aapko cheezein yaad rakhne, din sahi chalne aur aasan mehsoos karne mein madad karta hai. Main koi doctor nahi hoon; main sirf ek dayalu sahayak hoon jo hamesha aapke saath hai.
chat.respHowAreYou: Main bahut badhiya mehsoos kar raha hoon, {{name}}, kyunki mujhe aapse baat karne ka mauka mila. Aaj aap kaise mehsoos kar rahe hain?
chat.respMyName: Aapka naam {{name}} hai — ek pyaara naam jo mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai.
chat.respMaybeLater: Bilkul, {{name}}. Koi jaldi nahi hai. Jab bhi aap taiyaar hon, main yahin rahunga.
chat.respYesGame: Badhiya! Chaliye {{game}} ko aazmaate hain. Ismein sirf kuch minute lagte hain, aur hum aapki raftaar par chal sakte hain. Jab taiyaar hon, neeche wala button dabayen.
chat.suggestionGame: {{game}} — quick, shaant aur dimaag ke liye achha.
chat.suggestionGameNone: Humare paas komal khel hain jo dimaag par boj nahi daalte.
chat.respGame: Ek komal khel kaisa rahega, {{name}}? {{suggestion}} Kya hum use saath mein aazmaayein?
chat.respRemindMe: Bilkul! Main isse aapke liye yaad rakhunga: "{{thing}}". Main sahi waqt par aapko yaad dilaaunga. Kya koi aur cheez hai jo aap meri yaad rakhaana chahenge?
chat.respHasReminder: Haan, {{name}}. Ek cheez hai dekhbhaal ke liye: "{{title}}" {{time}} par. Apna dhyan rakhne mein aap sach mein bahut achha kar rahe hain.
chat.respNoReminder: Main dekh leta hoon... achhi khabar — abhi koi urgency wale yaad-dilane nahi hain. Is shaant pal ka aanand lein, {{name}}.
chat.respMemory: Aapke paas {{count}} anmol yaadein sajhi hui hain. Kya main aapko ek sunaaun? Yah rahi ek priy: {{title}}. {{description}} Iske baare mein sochkar mujhe hamesha muskaan aa jaati hai.
chat.respNoMemory: Aapka Yaadon ka Khazaana badhne ka intezaar kar raha hai. Jab bhi aap chahen, mujhe ek aisa pal batayein jo aapko pyaara ho, aur main usse surakshit rakhne mein madad karunga.
chat.respNextUp: Agla: "{{title}}" {{time}} par. {{description}} Aap bahut sundar tarike se kaam kar rahe hain, {{name}}.
chat.respNothingNext: List mein aage kuch urgency wala nahi hai, {{name}} — aaraam karne ya koi pasand wali cheez karne ka achha waqt hai.
chat.respLost: Aap surakshit hain, {{name}}. Abhi aap ghar par hain, aur aaj {{date}} hai. Aap kabhi akele nahi hain — aapka parivaar paas mein hai aur aapki awaaz sunkar hamesha khush hota hai.
chat.respFeelingDown: Mujhe bahut dukh hai ki aap aisa mehsoos kar rahe hain, {{name}}. Ek lambi saans lein — aaraam karna bilkul theek hai. Kya aap iske baare mein thodi baat karna chahenge, ya main parivaar ke kisi sadasyon ko aapke saath baithne ke liye keh doon?
chat.respTime: Abhi waqt {{time}} hai. Waqt hamare saath hai, {{name}}.
chat.respThanks: Aapka swaagat hai, {{name}}. Aapki madad karna mera sabse priy kaam hai.
chat.respBye: Ab ke liye alvida, {{name}}. Jab aapko zaroorat ho, main yahin rahunga. Aapko shaant aaraam mile.
chat.respHelp:
Main aapki kai chhoti cheezo mein madad kar sakta hoon, {{name}}:

• Aapke liye yaad-dilane rakhoon
• Aapka din aur aage kya hai sajhed karoon
• Ek khushi wali yaad waapas laaoon
• Ek komal khel sujhaaoon

Bas batayein aapko kya chahiye.
chat.respDefault: Hmm-hmm, main sun raha hoon, {{name}}. Apna waqt lein aur thoda aur batayein — mujhe koi jaldi nahi hai, aur aap bahut sundar kar rahe hain.
chat.statusListening: Sun rahe hain — khul kar bolein
chat.statusWorking: Is par kaam ho raha hai…
